summary: MPI scatters contiguous rank row and matching CSR intervals and rebases local row pointers. Timed host loop issues one GPU kernel per runtime iteration; the CPU outlined worker receives repeats, loops that bound with an OpenMP barrier per repetition, assigns all CPU rows, scans each CSR interval and stores. SASS assigns warps to GPU rows, each lane strides by 32 over the row's full [rowPtr,rowPtr+1) interval, reduces and stores lane 0; grid-stride row progression is present.

source_evidence.claim: CPU repeat/row/CSR loops; GPU warp/lane row and nonzero loops; MPI contiguous row/nnz partition and rebased pointers; timed GPU iterations plus CPU repeat call and synchronization.

compiled_evidence.claim: Runtime count controls GPU-stub launch loop; outlined worker receives the runtime count; worker loops repetitions through barrier, row assignments, CSR accumulation and stores, then host synchronizes before ending timing.
